title: Plugin Override ALL setting disabled
symptom: The '_Less common settings->Advanced Calibration->Plugin Override ALL_' setting is disabled and cannot be changed, preventing users from enabling it to solve calibration problems with Libre2+MM2+OOPalgorithm.
cause: The setting is placed behind engineering mode for testing only, and is not recommended for general use.
fix: Enable engineering mode to access the setting, but it is intended for developers and those who know what they are doing; otherwise, it is not recommended to use.
evidence_quote: In that case, the setting is placed behind engineering mode. That means the setting is not recommended to be used.
